title: GraphMaster: Automated Graph Synthesis via LLM Agents in Data-Limited Environments

layout.note: Four dash-dot regions of unequal size in a 2 by 2 arrangement: Manager top left, Evaluation top right, Perception bottom left (widest), Enhancement bottom right; thick pale arrows between regions trace a clockwise loop and thin coloured arrows run inside each region.

lesson: Give each agent its own colour and a robot head, and carry that colour through its dashed region, the arrows inside it and the artifacts it produces, so a multi-agent loop can be read by colour; use pale thick arrows for hand-offs between agents.
